title: Pullback preserves leaf rectangles
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic communication protocol over input types $X$ and $Y$, let $A \subseteq X$ and $B \subseteq Y$, and let $f_X : X' \to X$ and $f_Y : Y' \to Y$ be arbitrary maps. If $R \subseteq X \times Y$ is one of the leaf rectangles of $p$ relative to the constraint $A \times B$, then its pullback along $f_X \times f_Y$, namely $\{(x', y') \in X' \times Y' \mid (f_X(x'), f_Y(y')) \in R\}$, is one of the leaf rectangles of the pulled-back protocol $\mathrm{comap}(p, f_X, f_Y)$ relative to the constraint $f_X^{-1}(A) \times f_Y^{-1}(B)$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a protocol over X and Y
A is a subset of X
B is a subset of Y
R is a leaf rectangle of p relative to A and B
replaced:
If $R \in \texttt{leafRectanglesAux}(p, A, B)$ and $f_X : X' \to X$, $f_Y : Y' \to Y$, then
$\texttt{preimageInputSet}(f_X, f_Y, R) \in \texttt{leafRectanglesAux}(p.\texttt{comap}(f_X, f_Y),\, f_X^{-1}(A),\, f_Y^{-1}(B))$.
This is an internal auxiliary result proved by structural induction.
